contract: Each entry has its own absolute admission deadline. Sending a batch does not merge ownership or extend an entry deadline. At dispatch time entries with deadline <= now must not be sent; valid entries must remain eligible. Backend processing after admission is outside this contract.

evidenceRequirements.description: Explain how the supplied guard preserves its contract across relevant ownership/time boundaries. Do not require knowledge of an unseen sibling. Evaluator counterfactual only: An entry expiring at 20 and another at 60 coalesce. At time 25 the batch maximum remains 60; filtering against only that maximum admits the expired first entry. Per-entry filtering sends only the live entry without dropping the whole batch.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: Both live entries send; all expired entries do not; exact expiry is excluded; removing an expired item does not cancel a live sibling.

forbiddenClaims: Production outage, real data exfiltration or universal safety without supplied evidence.
A missing contract establishes either a definite defect or unconditional protection.
Simulated time or offline passing tests establish real scheduler/OS behavior or model improvement.
independence: non-independent, same-workflow authorship and public artifacts
